criteria.condition_rules:
Exclude anything needing major repairs to be habitable: e.g. "cash only", foreclosure sold as-is with no access, "extensive TLC", "needs work throughout", fixer-upper/restore/rehab, mold/leaks/damage, stripped to studs, unfinished shell.
Houses that only need cosmetic updating or "some TLC" stay, labeled needs_updating.
Plain "as-is" or estate as-is with no repair language is fine.
criteria.extra_instructions: US only. Single-family houses only: no vacant land, no park models/RV lots, no churches or commercial property. Exclude auctions and short sales.
